     4|*Kaito Varga: "We are not asking for permission anymore. We are stating a fact."*

     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a ceremonial pulse: Special Session of the Colonial Council Convened - Declaration of Self-Governance Vote Imminent. Kaito Varga adjusted his spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent knowing how historic moments actually feel, as he looked at the notification flashing across his console in the Valles Marineris Colonial Council's solemn chamber.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," he said, his voice carrying the rasp of years spent in leadership chambers and the quiet focus of generational resolve, "confirm the nature of this session."
